# Maintain the generated guidance

Run commands from the repository root:

- `npm run skills:generate`: regenerate configuration stories, this skill, component prompts, service prompts and pattern prompts.
- `npm run skills:check`: read-only verification of story coverage and every generated guidance file.
- `npm run skills:watch`: watch component, service, Storybook and generator sources and regenerate after changes; stop with Ctrl+C.
- `npm run check`: includes guidance freshness checks before builds; the existing pull-request CI already runs it.

After building Storybook, run `npm run skills:verify-storybook` to verify every generated story link against the actual Storybook index. The full check command includes this step.

Sources of truth are public Angular component/directive/service classes, their source-derived types, explicit Storybook metadata/render recipes and the configuration coverage manifest. Generation fails when a public component lacks catalog coverage and automatically indexes public injectable services exported by the package. It does not call an LLM, execute story code or need a running browser. It writes only the managed guidance files; unrelated files are preserved. API/type extraction uses the installed TypeScript compiler.

Generated patterns are candidate compositions detected from selectors in explicit render recipes. They are not inferred accessibility guarantees or production-ready templates. Review original CSF imports/helpers before using them.

To use this skill in another workspace, copy the complete `skills/arcwell-ui` directory into that workspace's skill location. The Markdown is usable by other LLMs directly. Source links require the repository checkout, and localhost links require Storybook on port 6006.
